name: Brothel Secrets 🔞
source:
The protagonist is an unemployed homeless man and a crook who comes to the brothel "Juicy Boobs" in search of freebies. He gets acquainted with Aphrodite, the barmaid and some girls. He gets into Aphrodite's confidence, as it seems to him, and the girls surround him with attention and affection. Golovnyi hero gets intimacy with one of the girls, thinking that it is for his "beautiful eyes" for free. But after he is billed and demands payment for services. 

There is no money and to avoid problems with security Golovniy hero agrees to work for the brothel as a laborer. Aphrodite introduces him to the illegal intricacies of the brothel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2721240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个失业的无家可归的人和一个骗子，他来到妓院“Juicy Boobs”寻找免费赠品。他结识了阿佛洛狄忒、酒吧女招待和一些女孩。在他看来，他赢得了阿芙罗狄蒂的信任，女孩们用关注和爱意围绕着他。戈洛夫尼英雄与其中一名女孩发生了亲密关系，认为这是免费的“美丽的眼睛”。但在他收到账单并要求支付服务费用后。

没有钱，为了避免安全问题，戈洛夫尼英雄同意在妓院当劳工。阿芙罗狄蒂向他介绍了妓院的非法行为。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2721240/]Steam[/url]]
